description: Dusk Orbit is a one-person team from Adana, Türkiye, at the Niğde local event. I'm working on the Dancing with the SARs challenge: using NASA-ISRO's new NISAR radar satellite to find out what changed in the farmland near my home after the first autumn rain, then testing the answer at random places around the world. Interests: Earth observation, data analysis and clear design. This is a solo team, so I'm not looking for new members.
